title: Summability of the halting-bit series
statement: For every natural number $J$, the series over $j \in \mathbb{N}$ with terms $h_{j+J}4^{-(j+1)}$ is summable, where $h_k=1$ if the $k$th natural number belongs to the halting set and $h_k=0$ otherwise.
